g.text: NUC tach simulator - Mode A (fixed RPM)

g.desc: NUC tach simulator - Mode A (fixed RPM)

g.text: J1 pin numbers are this board's labels, not Intel's. Intel publishes no pinout for this header - identify the four wires with a meter first.

g.desc: J1 pin numbers are this board's labels, not Intel's. Intel publishes no pinout for this header - identify the four wires with a meter first.

g.text: Q1 is open-collector: it only ever pulls NUC_TACH low. The pull-up lives in the NUC.

g.desc: Q1 is open-collector: it only ever pulls NUC_TACH low. The pull-up lives in the NUC.

g.text: BIOS reads RPM = 30 x tach frequency. 50 Hz = 1500 RPM, 133 Hz = 4000 RPM.

g.desc: BIOS reads RPM = 30 x tach frequency. 50 Hz = 1500 RPM, 133 Hz = 4000 RPM.

g.text: J2: pin1 -> Arduino D9, pin2 -> 5V into the Pro Mini's RAW pin, pin3 -> GND. 3.3V / 8MHz board: its own regulator makes 3.3V, so 5V never goes to VCC. Header is rated 0.25A total.
